My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I came across the Embedded System Engineer opening at Call Quest Solution and wanted to reach out. I recently completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT, with hands-on experience in bare-metal C firmware, STM32 peripherals, RTOS, and embedded hardware integration.

A few highlights: STM32 Cortex-M4 firmware at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM, YOLOv8 real-time tracking on NVIDIA Jetson with FreeRTOS and UART-to-STM32 control, and PCB design with I2C/UART sensor integration.

I know your role is on a different side of the organization — if you happen to know who handles engineering hiring at Call Quest, I would really appreciate a nudge in the right direction.

Thank you in advance.
draft.hook_used: Same company, leadership/recruiting background in bio
